correctness.rationale: For each pair-sign coordinate the unrestricted covariance is (I+B^T B)/3 by exact three- and four-label ordering counts. Transposition of two unused labels pairs even/odd permutations for moments supported on up to four labels when n>=6. The explicit signed disjoint-edge matrices H4,H5 yield positive even covariance and verified identities H4^2=I, H4 exchanges gradient/circulation, H5 P=0, H5^2=5Q, trace H5=0. The spectral formulas follow. A_n acts transitively by signed-orthogonal edge-coordinate permutations, making every squared Mahalanobis norm exactly d; averaging and AM-GM on covariance proves unique full-dimensional optimal enclosing ellipsoid against arbitrary center/orientation. Exact rational checker enumerated all even and unrestricted rank permutations n=4,5,6, verified covariances, eigenvalues, determinant ratios 64/125,64/125,1 and all vertex contacts. Finite computations are certificates for n4/5 and cross-checks for n6, not a substitute for all-n parity proof.

value.rationale: The ellipsoid is the canonical optimal enclosing quadratic metric of all transitive-tournament preference rankings. Parity is a natural half-vertex restriction. In two exceptional dimensions it causes precisely the same nontrivial volume loss 8/(5 sqrt 5) despite different spectra; with six labels, any pair of edge comparisons sees two unused labels and parity becomes invisible, so the full optimal ellipsoid is recovered exactly. This is a sharp structural geometry/representation threshold and gives exact axes and contacts for all orders; it is not just a numeric recomputation or a generic covariance observation.
